title: AMBA AXI4-Lite subordinate: a 256-word memory with byte strobes, independent read and write paths, SLVERR outside the memory

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: an access outside the memory or misaligned was accepted (SLVERR); the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: awaddr, awvalid, awready, wdata, wstrb, wvalid, wready, bresp, bvalid, bready, araddr, arvalid, arready, rdata, rresp, rvalid and rready are the AXI4-Lite subordinate pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the subordinate's error event.

The memory is bytes 0x000 to 0x3FF; an address above it or not word aligned gets SLVERR (a write is dropped, a read returns 0). Only OKAY and SLVERR are returned, so bresp[0] and rresp[0] are constant 0 (waived).
